messages:
olivia: heads-up: planning a very small v2 slow-push during the 03:00 UTC change window. plan: start at 3% for 12m, then optional 10% hold. want short rollback criteria and any special pinlist notes.

raj: quick note: v2 tightens URL param validation; some proxies append debugging params. suggest a gateway striplist for known-debug params during the window.

ops_lee: propose rollback triggers: 5xx > 0.45% sustained over 3 consecutive 1m buckets OR error-rate delta > 4x baseline for any tenant over 90s -> auto-rollback. p95 latency > 650ms for 2 consecutive 1m windows -> suspend ramp. will wire alerts to @eng-oncall.

megan: docs checklist: add a tiny blurb in release notes about URL param handling and a migration snippet. also add telemetry tag `rollout:sz-1749801111`.

deploybot: scheduled by olivia at 2025-08-20T03:00:00Z. action id sz-1749801111. initial route: 3% to v2 for 12m. will capture failed payloads to s3://rollouts/sz-1749801111/failed.

olivia: gating: enable gateway striplist, tenant-quarantine with threshold 1% error, and a short-lived header `x-rw-lax=true` for 6h to reduce noisy rejections.

raj: gateway striplist deployed to staging; smoke passed. faster than patching runtime. will enable on the toggle.

deploybot: toggle started at 2025-08-20T03:00:00Z -> 3% to v2 (monitor sz-1749801111). preflight smoke passed.

ops_lee: first 5m metrics: p50 88ms, p95 172ms, 5xx 0.02% — healthy.

megan: spotted a tiny cluster of schema-type errors from a handful of legacy server integrations (0.01%). samples logged. adding known-issue note: "legacy integrations may need to drop debug params".

raj: recommendation: hold at 3% for full 12m; if stable, manually bump to 10% and remove `x-rw-lax` after 6h. consider adding the affected tenants to pinlist until they patch.

olivia: agree. manual bump only after 12m stable. rollback CLI (ops_lee please confirm):
```
# emergency rollback
deploybot rollback --route /api --from v2 --to v1 --id sz-1749801111 --reason "auto-threshold"
```

ops_lee: verified. alerts wired. will auto-execute rollback if thresholds reached and announce prior to action. also implemented a 90s confirmation window to reduce flapping.

deploybot: status update at 2025-08-20T03:10:12Z: 3% -> v2 active. monitor sz-1749801111. tenant-quarantine enabled.

megan: updating release notes and the short customer advisory now. PR opened: https://go/internal/docs/pull/3319 (WIP).

olivia: thanks. leaving thread open for the remainder of the window. if mobile or server teams see issues, paste samples and tag `rollout:sz-1749801111`. :thumbsup:
